new_leaves.name: scholzeH1AbVar
new_leaves.doc: Scholze, p-adic Hodge theory for rigid-analytic varieties, Forum Math. Pi 1 (2013), Cor. 1.8 with Thms 9.1 and 9.3 and the corrigendum Forum Math. Pi 4 (2016) e6, applied as in diophantine_zq.tex lem:de-rham-descent L10954-10965 (step C3), with the Hodge numbers of H^1_dR(A/F) (L10996, '2,2' for the abelian surface, uncited): for A an abelian variety of dimension g over a finite F/Q_p, H^1_et(A_Fbar, Q_p) is de Rham, the Hodge filtration of D_dR has its jumps in [0, 1], and dim_{Q_p} Fil^1 D_dR = [F:Q_p] g. Lean form over derham-scholze's objects: H^1 = Q_p (x)_{Z_p} Scheme.EllAdicCohomology (A x_F Spec Fbar) p 1 (Mathlib's pro-etale l-adic cohomology), sigma by transport along 1 x Spec(sigma^-1) (rhoH = t10-etale's galH); D_dR = (B_dR (x) W)^{G_F} (ddrFam), Fil^j = D_dR meet (t^j B_dR^+ (x) W) (filD). The manuscript-exact g = 2 form is DeRhamScholze.HTMerge.ScholzeH1AbSurf (implied, scholzeH1AbSurf_of_abVar).
